name: ds-contracts-poc
description: Proof of concept: machine-readable design-system contracts. The v1 proof surface is recipe-IR (archetype recipes + Figma-capability IR + receipts); product v1 is incomplete (F1). The universal JSON contract still powers the CLI, playground, and Journeys A–C.
